comments.body:
Quest: The Emperor's Villa (Athens Adventure Mediator)
3*
Recognition r4
Archaelogy r6
Italian

Summary: You've investigated one of the Five Good Emperors of Ancient Rome, Hadrian, before, right? This time, we have a request regarding one of the structures he is said to have built. The client is the gatekeeper of Genoa. He was complaining how much he hates his job... First, try listening to what he has to say.

Genoa's Gatekeeper: - In the land east of here, apparently there is a villa built by one of the Roman emperors. I would like to see it myself, but because of work, I cannot leave this town... So, do you think you can go ivestigate this villa for me? There's a scholar in town who is knowledgeable on Ancient Rome, and such. Just this one favor, please!

Genoa's Scholar: - Indeed, that was built by the Wise Emperor Hadrian. It's an extremely splendid villa in the spa town of Tivoli, which was the East of Rome. It seems there are somehow several cases of emperors reviving charming old buildings whenever they went out to survey their lands. I think you should head Northeast from Naples.

Clue: It seems that Hadrian's Villa was extremely grand, designed with a row of buildings. The Gatekeeper will be looking forward to hearing about this. Immediately head Northeast from Naples, to the area with red flowers, and confirm this story.

Card- Discovery: Villa Adriana, 3* Historic Site
(A large complex constructed as a retreat from Rome for Roman Emperor Hadrain at Tivoli, Italy. It is filled with reproductions of the emperor's favorite buildings of the Roman world.)
